cds.text: Represent and approximate composite shapes and objects using combinations of familiar shapes
Connect objects to their nets and build objects from nets using spatial and geometric reasoning
Compare parallel cross-sections of objects and recognise their relationship to right prisms
Create and interpret grid reference systems to locate and describe positions and pathways
Construct a grid coordinate system to locate positions; use coordinates and directional language to describe position and movement
Locate points in the four quadrants of a Cartesian plane; describe coordinate changes when a point moves
Recognise line and rotational symmetry in shapes and create symmetrical patterns and pictures, using dynamic geometry software where appropriate
Describe and perform translations, reflections and rotations of shapes; identify what changes, what stays the same, and any symmetries
Use combinations of transformations to create tessellations and other geometric patterns, using dynamic geometry software where appropriate
